<details>
<summary>How it works</summary>

- [`scripts/update-board.mjs`](scripts/update-board.mjs) finds every public PR I've authored outside my own repos, keeps repos with at least `minStars` stars, and regenerates this board, the summary card, and the [dashboard](https://lsyurea.github.io/Open-Source/).
- A PR counts as merged if GitHub merged it or a commit closed it (e.g. PyTorch's merge bot).
- My [profile README](https://github.com/lsyurea) calls the same workflow with `layout: profile`.
- Filters live in [`board.config.json`](board.config.json). Local run: `GITHUB_TOKEN=$(gh auth token) node scripts/update-board.mjs`

</details>
